migrationCurrentnessRules: same filename with changed SQL changes the migration-set checksum and fails old history matching
adding a migration changes the migration-set checksum and fails incomplete history matching
history rows must match the current ordered manifest exactly
unrelated admin or Context7 cache changes do not affect the migration-set checksum
migrationReuseRules: Only current ordered manifest plus matching Factory migration history and schema verification may be reused.
missingMigrationBehavior: db:validate rejects an empty migration directory; db:migrate and db:verify emit MIGRATION_SET_EMPTY for the Factory domain.
staleMigrationBehavior: db:migrate emits MIGRATION_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH; db:verify emits MIGRATION_EVIDENCE_STALE.
failedMigrationBehavior: existing transaction rollback is preserved and no success evidence is emitted.
partialMigrationBehavior: history completeness and ordered checksum matching fail closed; partial execution cannot satisfy the set.
notRequiredBehavior: No-migration-required is not a valid state for the Factory persistence schema; generated/customer migration semantics are outside cg-15.
transactionBehavior: new migration SQL and history insertion remain in one transaction; already-applied migrations are idempotent and do not run a new transaction.
